differential_expression_rows.name: differential_expression_rows
differential_expression_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- core identifiers (grain)
  gene_symbol,
  doid,
  -- required statistics (lift question-specific literals out: no literals here)
  pvalue,
  log2fc,
  adjpvalue,
  statistical_significance,
  expression_change_direction,
  subjects_total
FROM
  differential_expression
WHERE
  -- exclude NULL pvalues so downstream stats remain valid
  pvalue IS NOT NULL
differential_expression_rows.description: Row-level subset of differential expression measurements with core columns and no aggregation; excludes NULL pvalues to keep downstream stats valid (note: question-specific disease filtering is left to question_ops).

diseases_with_lung_in_name.name: diseases_with_lung_in_name
diseases_with_lung_in_name.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  name
FROM
  disease
WHERE
  name ILIKE '%' || 'lung' || '%'
diseases_with_lung_in_name.description: Cohort of diseases whose name mentions 'lung' (captures lung cancer and lung-related disease rows); useful to resolve user terms like 'lung cancer' to DOIDs.

differential_expression_with_disease_nam.name: differential_expression_with_disease_name
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol,
  de.doid,
  de.pvalue,
  de.log2fc,
  de.adjpvalue,
  de.statistical_significance,
  de.expression_change_direction,
  d.name AS disease_name
FROM
  differential_expression_rows de
LEFT JOIN
  disease d
ON
  de.doid = d.id
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.description: Denormalized view joining differential_expression to disease to expose disease name alongside each measurement for easy text-based filtering and reporting.
